tool_input.body:
## Summary

`code-reviewer`, `silent-failure-hunter`, and `invariant-completeness-reviewer` are deployed by `ethos seed` to `.claude/agents/` and are referenced by the Gate 3 local-review workflow, but they were never committed — they sat untracked in the working tree. The sibling expert agents (`jck`/`jdc`/`gjm`/`sjl`/`latex-tech-architect`) are tracked and `.claude/agents/` is not gitignored, so these belong in the repo on the same footing.

Fixed the markdownlint violations in the seeded content (MD012 double blank, MD036 emphasis-as-heading, MD032 lists needing surrounding blanks) so `make lint` stays green.

This clears the last untracked files from the working tree after the macOS-runner migration work (#240–#242).

## Test plan

- [x] `make lint` → 0 errors across all 110 markdown files
- [ ] CI green
